messages.author: 9532c6cd6f700d65
messages.subject: plotly config, credentials on shinyapps
parts:
Hello all,

I have an app that uses plotly extensively and it runs fine locally.  The default location of the .config and .credentials files is ~/.plotly/, but that base directory can't be created on ShinyApps...resulting in errors such as:

Warning in file.create(abspath) :
cannot create file '//.plotly/.credentials', reason 'No such file or directory'
argument is not interpretable as logical

I tried setting the directories and file paths manually at the top of ui.R (and server.R), i.e., before the call to require(plotly) or to shinyUI, with

PLOTLY_DIR <- file.path(path.expand("."), ".plotly")
CREDENTIALS_FILE <- file.path(PLOTLY_DIR, ".credentials")
CONFIG_FILE <- file.path(PLOTLY_DIR, ".config")

but to no avail.  Also did rm -r ~/.plotly to start clean and the directory/files were again created in ~...and after poring over the repo I can't find where the values are initialized.

Any ideas on how to set the relevant paths so that plotly will work on ShinyApps.io?

Thanks

messages.author: edbcc711cdbb3da8
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] plotly config, credentials on shinyapps
parts:
Hi Jacob,
Unfortunately we aren't sufficiently familiar with Plotly to know how to configure it so that it isn't placing its files outside of the directory that the app runs in. For shinyapps.io to work for your applications, the data that it needs has to be contained in the same directory as the application itself.  The application won't have access to ~/XXX, and you will want to access everything as a relative path from where the ui.R and server.R files live.

messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] plotly config, credentials on shinyapps
parts:
Thanks, Tareef.  I was figuring out the answer when your reply came in.  For anyone else trying to make plotly and shinyapps.io work together, this is what I did:
  • clone the rOpenSci/plotly repo into your Shiny app directory (alongside server.R, ui.R, and any helper files)
  • in plotly/R/tools.R, change the tilde (~) in line 3 to '.', i.e., PLOTLY_DIR <- file.path(path.expand("."), ".plotly")
  • install package IRdisplay using devtools::install_github("IRkernel/IRdisplay")
  • rather than using library(plotly) or require(plotly), source the .R files in ./plotly/R/; 
  • bring in the packages that plotly uses with library/require, which includes the following packages: RCurl, RJSONIO, lattice, xtable, and httr.
  • deploy to shinyapps.io
Jacob
